_comment: Assistant safety settings (#281, #563: an assistant is a persistent session that reads the project and changes nothing in it, held by Claude Code's own permissions). Replace /ABSOLUTE/PATH with the absolute path of the project's core copy, <project>/coordinator/core (the folder that holds scripts/), and /ABSOLUTE/PROJECT/coordinator/assistants/NAME with the assistant's folder (NAME: its name) - in env COORD_ASSISTANT_DIR and in the Edit rules, which write an absolute path with a leading // (//home/x/...). defaultMode dontAsk (start-worker also starts an assistant with --permission-mode dontAsk): every tool call no allow rule names is refused at once, with no prompt - and the guard refuses an assistant's edit, Bash and PowerShell calls in any other mode. The allow list is closed, reads only: Read, Grep, Glob; Edit (which covers Write, MultiEdit and NotebookEdit) inside the assistant's folder only; gh issue / pr / run / repo reads by fixed prefixes; SendMessage and ListAgents to talk to the coordinator; Claude Code's own read-only shell commands pass by its own check (measured on 2.1.322: ls, cat, and git status / log / diff / show / rev-parse in the session's folder, the project root; refused: git -C <dir> ..., cd <dir> && git ..., git --no-pager ..., git log --output=...), so no git rule is listed: a wildcard such as git -C * log would also match git -C . branch -D log. Never add a rule that can write or run code: no gh api, no git write form, no interpreter. A refusal in dontAsk invites another route, so the deny list names the writes besides: every git and GitHub write form an allow rule in another settings file (the user's own, the project's) could let through - a deny always wins - the whole PowerShell tool (an assistant reads through Bash), and the edit of the core copy, the assistants' settings, the project's .claude/ and ~/.claude/. A user-level allow rule still reaches an assistant for anything not denied here: keep the user's allow list free of writes, or deny them here too. worktree.bgIsolation none: the assistant works in its folder, not a worktree. MCP tools: their writes are denied by name (the GitHub server connected as "github": rename to this machine's server name); a connector the assistant's brief names goes into allow tool by tool, only its reads. env COORD_PROTECTED_BRANCHES: as in settings.example.json (the guard's general rules still apply: a push to a protected branch is blocked). attribution hides the AI co-author trailer, the PR line and the session link (CORE section 11). The compact hook runs after-compact.sh assistant: after each compaction the assistant re-reads its own BRIEF.md and NOTES.md (COORD_ASSISTANT_DIR) and the core's roles/assistant.md. This file only - never the coordinator's own settings (TOOLKIT.md Safety, Assistants).
